QuestInfo.name: Protect the Fireworks Festival!
QuestInfo.0: The Fireworks that were going to be used #rto celebrate the close of the Legends Festival#k got wet from heavy rain and won't work. Luckily, #p9010010#'s Magic Powder can absorb the moisture from the Fireworks and make them usable again. Talk to #p9000021# or click on the #i3994375# Event Notifier on the left side of the screen for more.
QuestInfo.1: You placed the #t3994393# in the Magic Powder. After #b30 minutes#k, they will become #t3994394#.
QuestInfo.2: You dried the Wet Fireworks using the Magic Powder, took them to #p9000021#, and received a reward.

0.0: Hi there! First, thank you for all your help with the Legends Festival! You were a big part of making this whole thing such a success. To bring it all to a close, I was going to have a fireworks show, but some idiot left the fireworks out in the rain, and now they're all wet and ruined. I've got a plan, but I need your help.

yes.0:
Thank you, Legendary Hero! I had a feeling you were going to help me. 

Place Wet Fireworks in Cassandra's Magic Powder and wait for 30 minutes. The powder will absorb the water and make them good as new! I'll have to be sure to thank Cassandra for this later.

All right, click on the Event Notifier on the left side of the screen after 30 minutes and give me the dried-out Fireworks!

no.0: Really? I thought you would help me. I'm giving out Legends Maple Coins, too. Would that change your mind...?

default.0: I don't think the Fireworks are completely dry yet. Could you wait a little longer?
